hooks.name: Suggest a Fagan inspection
hooks.description: After each agent turn, show an inspection suggestion when changed lines exceed suggestThresholdLoc and no open inspection covers them. Acknowledgment does not open an inspection.

confirm.question: Fagan's Ghost could not check this diff. Check the installed .fagan/bin/fagan.mjs bundle, then run node scripts/fagan-hook.mjs hook suggest to check manually. This acknowledgment does not open an inspection.
